title: Define normalized system event contract
businessObjective: Advance Phase 1 — Trusted control foundation through one bounded, static normalized-event contract.
technicalObjective: Create the version 1 normalized system-event JSON Schema and its deterministic offline validator exactly as defined in docs/event-contracts/NORMALIZED_SYSTEM_EVENT_CONTRACT.md.
architectureReferences: docs/architecture/source/Sri U-Thong Grand Hotel AI OS.md
assumptions: No production write, deployment, live credential access, event ingestion, queue, database, or external service access is authorized.
The schema and validator are static repository artifacts; the validator uses Node built-ins only and must not install packages.
Interfaces with the finalized platform use approved compatibility contracts only.

tests/event-contracts/validate-normalized-system-event-contract.mjs deterministically accepts the finite valid case and rejects every documented invalid case without network or external state.
The exact validator command and fast governance verification pass, and independent verification confirms forbidden paths were untouched.
solEscalationTriggers: Any required change crosses the declared subsystem or protected paths.
Any production access, credential, payment, booking, RLS, migration, authorization, concurrency, workflow-correctness, delivery, or payload privacy ambiguity arises.
rollbackExpectations: Revert the event-contract schema, validator, generated artifacts, task-state record, and evidence together; preserve audit and verification evidence.
